description: Read-only Odysseus maintenance bootstrap and existing UI quality review.

hooks.command: sh -c 'unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_COMMON_DIR GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_CONFIG GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM GIT_CONFIG_COUNT GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES GIT_DISCOVERY_ACROSS_FILESYSTEM GIT_NAMESPACE GIT_SHALLOW_FILE GIT_REPLACE_REF_BASE GIT_GRAFT_FILE GIT_EXEC_PATH GIT_SSH GIT_SSH_COMMAND GIT_ASKPASS GIT_TRACE GIT_TRACE2 GIT_TRACE2_EVENT GIT_TRACE2_PERF GIT_TRACE_REDACT GIT_TRACE_SETUP GIT_TRACE_PERFORMANCE GIT_TRACE_PACKET GIT_TRACE_CURL GIT_TRACE_CURL_NO_DATA GIT_FLUSH GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT GIT_PAGER; export GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_PAGER=cat; repo_root="$(git -c safe.directory=* -c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.untrackedCache=false rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && cd "$repo_root" && exec python -B -m src.runtime_tool_status'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$gitEnvKeys = @('GIT_DIR','GIT_WORK_TREE','GIT_INDEX_FILE','GIT_COMMON_DIR','GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY','GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES','GIT_CONFIG','GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM','GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL','GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM','GIT_CONFIG_COUNT','GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS','GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES','GIT_DISCOVERY_ACROSS_FILESYSTEM','GIT_NAMESPACE','GIT_SHALLOW_FILE','GIT_REPLACE_REF_BASE','GIT_GRAFT_FILE','GIT_EXEC_PATH','GIT_SSH','GIT_SSH_COMMAND','GIT_ASKPASS','GIT_TRACE','GIT_TRACE2','GIT_TRACE2_EVENT','GIT_TRACE2_PERF','GIT_TRACE_REDACT','GIT_TRACE_SETUP','GIT_TRACE_PERFORMANCE','GIT_TRACE_PACKET','GIT_TRACE_CURL','GIT_TRACE_CURL_NO_DATA','GIT_FLUSH','GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS','GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT','GIT_PAGER'); foreach ($gitEnvKey in $gitEnvKeys) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath ('Env:' + $gitEnvKey) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; $env:GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS = '0'; $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT = '0'; $env:GIT_PAGER = 'cat'; $repoRoot = (& git -c 'safe.directory=*' -c 'core.fsmonitor=false' -c 'core.untrackedCache=false' rev-parse --show-toplevel); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; Set-Location -LiteralPath $repoRoot; & python -B -m src.runtime_tool_status"
